Analysis.object: Sociocultural pressures play a central role in disordered eating across genders, with gender-specific pathways—emotion regulation and self-esteem in females, and sport pressures and negative mood in males
The cross-sectional, self-reported design, lack of model validation, small sample (especially males), and absence of sport-type comparisons limit causal inference and generalizability
Future studies should use longitudinal designs, larger and more diverse samples, and examine differences across sport types, competition levels, and developmental stages

Population.object: Aged between 14 ans 20, officially registered in a sports club, participated in organized regional, national, or international competitions and club training and fluent in one of the official languages (French, German, or Italian)
